patterns.note: A full-page interactive canvas serves as the primary content display, transitioning from a radial diagram to a dynamic node-based network.
All text is rendered in a clean, uppercase sans-serif, with a relatively small and consistent size, emphasizing a technical or data-driven aesthetic.
A stark monochrome palette of light grey and black dominates, with white text on dark backgrounds after scroll, creating high contrast.
The page undergoes a dramatic scroll-triggered transformation, shifting from a static light-themed radial diagram to a dark, animated 3D-like constellation of interconnected nodes and labels.
Content is presented as interconnected nodes within a continuous, interactive canvas rather than distinct, stacked sections.

technique_notes: The site uses a full-page canvas for a highly interactive and dynamic background. On scroll, the canvas content and background color dramatically transform from a light-themed 2D radial diagram into a dark, 3D-like constellation of interconnected nodes, revealing new labels and a sense of depth. This motion is orchestrated using canvas animation techniques combined with CSS keyframes for text elements, creating a seamless, immersive experience that encourages exploration.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, consistent uppercase text with subtle size variations for hierarchy, maintaining a minimal and technical character.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with ample negative space around all elements, contributing to a minimal and focused presentation.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its complete abandonment of traditional page layouts in favor of a single, immersive, scroll-driven interactive canvas that transforms from a conceptual diagram into a dynamic, explorable 3D-like network of interconnected ideas and skills.
